name: sc2-adjutant
description: sc2-adjutant's Claude Code plugin, for co-designing StarCraft II campaign Missions.

plugins.name: sc2-adjutant
plugins.description: The sc2-adjutant MCP server for the Workspace you have open, the level-design, hero-mission-design, encounter-design, ally-design, exemplar-design, texture-sets, doodad-search, custom-doodads, cinematography, boss-design and boss-build skills, the melee-design skill for 1v1 melee maps, the report-missing-feature skill for reporting what sc2-adjutant can't do yet, and commands for the co-design session.
